test_title: PYST 45: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which of the following budget sessions was the Mission Antyodaya, a convergence and accountability framework aiming to bring optimum use and management of resources, adopted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Budget 2017-18**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mission Antyodaya**, a convergence and accountability framework aimed at optimal resource management, was officially adopted in the **Union Budget 2017-18**.
 
• The initiative focuses on **uplifting the poorest households** through targeted interventions in villages across India.
 
• **Key objectives** include reducing poverty, improving livelihood opportunities, and ensuring sustainable development through efficient convergence of schemes.
 
• It integrates various governmental schemes and programs to ensure better service delivery and promote grassroots-level accountability.
 
• The mission emphasizes creating measurable outcomes and tracking progress using data-driven approaches and surveys.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Union Budget 2018-19**

 
 
• This budget introduced the **Ayushman Bharat Scheme**, aimed at providing health insurance coverage of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year.
 
• Another major initiative was the **Operation Green**, focusing on enhancing the income of farmers through better price realization for crops like tomato, onion, and potato.
 
• It also emphasized the development of infrastructure through the **Affordable Housing Fund** under the National Housing Bank.
 
 
 
• **Union Budget 2016-17**
 
 
• This budget focused on the rural sector, agriculture, and poverty alleviation, introducing schemes like **Krishi Kalyan Cess**.
 
• It aimed to double farmers' incomes by 2022 through investments in irrigation, crop insurance, and rural development.
 
• The budget also highlighted the need for financial reforms and launched initiatives like **Digital Literacy Mission**.
 
 
 
• **Union Budget 2015-16**
 
 
• The budget introduced the **Atal Pension Yojana**, a pension scheme aimed at providing old-age income security to unorganized workers.
 
• It focused on financial inclusion and social security by launching schemes like **Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana** and **Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana**.
 
• Infrastructure development was emphasized with the allocation of funds for roads, railways, and energy projects.
